row.team_price_text: Standard: $6.30/mo billed annually in the first year ($75.60, then $108/yr), 3 seats
row.evidence: Sender's pricing page lists SSO (SAML v2) and advanced user permissions on Enterprise (Custom price) but no SCIM or user provisioning on any plan, and the help centre and API reference have no SCIM documentation.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none), now by absence at medium confidence: no SCIM on the pricing page, help-centre sitemap (338 articles), llms.txt or API reference. Plans renamed since June: Free, Standard, Professional, Enterprise (June's 'Starter: $17/mo (1,000 contacts)' is gone). Priced by subscriber count with flat seat bundles (Free 1, Standard 3, Professional 10, Enterprise unlimited), so per-user fields are null. Card prices include a 30% first-year discount for new users; llms.txt says Standard 'from $7/month', which conflicts with the $6.30 card. Enterprise (Custom price) adds SSO (SAML v2), advanced user permissions and activity logs.

scim.notes: Not offered by absence: the Enterprise feature list (SSO, advanced user permissions, activity logs) never mentions SCIM or provisioning.

user_api.notes: The public REST API (https://api.sender.net/v2/) covers subscribers, groups, segments, fields, campaigns, workflows and webhooks (marketing contacts), with no endpoints for account users or roles. 'false' is by absence from the full API reference.
